what: Four designs for getting records from elsewhere were in the tree before this lane (the SHA-256 gateway plan, blaze-global's per-record signed cache with bundles, the store's remote tier, the chunk-tree fetch core), none wired to a build, each with its own manifest, trust and wire. Finding out which was current took the first third of the lane.
cost: about 150k tokens of reading before the first line was written
cause: each lane designed the piece it was asked for beside the others and the plan doc was appended to, not rewritten
whys: a new lane could not tell which design to extend
the doc's status line says `plan` for all of them
nothing lists which remote mechanisms are wired and which are libraries
each was specified and partly built without the build path that would have forced one choice
rule spec-then-build was followed per lane, one-concept-one-home was not checked across lanes
class: parallel designs of one concept that never meet at a caller
prevention: one row per remote mechanism in the objectives ledger with `wired: yes/no` and its caller; docs/remote-cache.md split so the built part (Packs) is `current` and the gateway plan is its own `plan` doc; delete or fold blaze-global's bundle and `verified.rs` once packs carry their cases
workaround: the Packs section now says which it replaces and why
